description: Dijkenstelsels (punten) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaaloverijssel.nl. In the low-lying Netherlands there is flooding of all times. In order to limit this flooding, the population began to protect themselves against flooding in the Middle Ages by building dikes along the Zuiderzee and - presumably already - along the large river, such as the IJssel. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Dike systems (points)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2013-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
